verdict.rationale: AWS CLI is explicitly designed for scripting/automation ('download and configure... automate them through scripts'), supports credential-based non-interactive auth, and integrates with CI via OIDC roles (e.g., GitHub Actions) for headless operation without stored secrets. CloudFormation/CDK further enable fully headless infra automation. Missing for 10: no direct first-party CI/CD product docs (e.g., CodePipeline specifics) or independent case study of AWS CLI in CI pipelines.
